## Problem

Describe the expected and observed behavior.

## Synthetic reproduction

Provide minimal commands and synthetic inputs.
Include relevant plugin, SDK, Go, and operating system versions.
Remove credentials, real catalog values, prompt text, private paths, and conversation identifiers.

## Evidence

Report checks as passed, failed, blocked, or not run.
Summarize the result without attaching raw operator logs.

## Acceptance

Describe the observable result that would resolve this issue.
